sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: There he is. End of the line, horse.

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.text: Dude... he looks sad.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Ah. You found him. Gustav knew you would come.

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.text: Wait, how did SHE get here before us?

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: GUSTAV! Gustav, bitte, please! Come back to Hans-Jürgen!

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Gustav, no... why do you run from me?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: He runs because you did not listen. Sixteen years, Hans-Jürgen.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: He is... he is a horse! Horses do not...

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Horses understand more than you think.

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.text: Wait... I have these Skittles. You think he'd want...?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: The rainbow candies. Gustav remembers. Give them.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: The Skittles? He always loved those...

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.text: He's coming! Don't move, don't move...

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: I can't believe that worked.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: He trusts you now. The rainbow has opened the door.

sequence.speaker: papageno_franz
sequence.text: Papageno will try! Birds and horses are friends!

sequence.speaker: papageno_franz
sequence.text: *whistles* Papageno knows freedom. Papageno was once caged too.

sequence.speaker: papageno_franz
sequence.text: Not Skittles, but seeds! Gustav likes seeds too!

sequence.speaker: papageno_franz
sequence.text: Gustav says he will listen. But only because Papageno asked.

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: Come on, just grab him!

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: NO! GUSTAV!

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: He is gone. Gustav is gone forever.

opening.speaker: hans_jurgen
opening.text: Gustav... I did not know. Sixteen years. Sixteen years I work you. Never once I ask... is he happy?

player_choices.text: Maybe Gustav doesn't want to quit. He just wants respect.
Look at him. He's happy here. You can't cage freedom.
Can we... ask Gustav what he wants?

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: Maybe Gustav doesn't want to quit. He just wants... respect.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Respect? For a horse?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Gustav says... he would consider returning. But he has conditions.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Conditions? What conditions?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: No more bachelor parties. Shorter routes. And Skittles. Many Skittles.

choices.text: That seems reasonable for 16 years of service.
Actually, maybe he should just retire.

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.text: Look at him. He's happy here. You can't cage freedom, dude.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: But... but he is MY horse. My livelihood...

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Gustav says he has given you sixteen years. He asks only for peace.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: The insurance... they will pay for retirement. But Gustav...

choices.text: Let him go, Hans-Jürgen. He's earned it.
Actually, maybe he could still work sometimes?

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.text: Can we... ask Gustav what he wants?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: A wise question. Gustav... what do you wish?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: *listens to Gustav's body language* He says... he is tired.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Tired of the cobblestones. Tired of the tourists. Tired of the smell of beer.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: But he also says... he does not hate Hans-Jürgen. Only the work.

choices.text: So he'd go back if things changed?
What if he became a park horse instead?

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: No more bachelor parties. Shorter routes. Skittles.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: I... I can do this. For Gustav. For my partner.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Gustav... will you come home? I promise. Things will be different.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: He says... he will try. But one bachelor party, and he runs again.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: *crying* Thank you, Gustav. Thank you, strange Americans.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: You are right. Sixteen years... perhaps he has earned this.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Go, old friend. You have earned your... retirement.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Gustav says... thank you. To all of you.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Goodbye, Gustav. I will visit. I promise.

sequence.speaker: papageno_franz
sequence.text: The bird-man has an idea! What if Gustav becomes... a PARK horse?

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: A park horse? Like... he lives here?

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: The park does need a guardian. Gustav could live here, free.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: A park horse... I could visit. He would be safe. Happy.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: Gustav says... this is acceptable. He likes the grass.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: For your help... I reduce your debt. €500 less. It is the least I can do.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: And if you ever need a ride in Sinfonia... Hans-Jürgen's fiaker is at your service. Half price.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: The rainbow brought peace. Gustav will remember your kindness.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: I will visit every day. The insurance will help. And Gustav... Gustav will be happy.

sequence.speaker: pigeon_lady
sequence.text: The pigeons and I will watch over him. We always have.

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.text: That was... actually kind of beautiful.

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: He is gone. Gustav is gone forever. What have I done?

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.text: Dude... we lost a horse.

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: We lost more than that, Chad.

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: You know what? Not our problem. Let's go.

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.text: But the horse—

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.text: NOT. OUR. PROBLEM.

sequence.speaker: regisseur_hoffmann
sequence.text: Now. About my €2,000...

sequence.speaker: hans_jurgen
sequence.text: Director, please. My insurance will cover some. These Americans... they helped.

choices.text: Fine, fine. Here's the money. (Pay full)
Look, we're good for it. Installment plan? (Pay €500)
You want to take this outside? (Bravado 4)
